scope: Opt-in real Windows capture -> live Jev -> native cover -> button recovery. No capture/provider fixtures. Initial configuration seeded into an isolated profile; onboarding is not tested.

rule.name: YouTube
rule.instruction: Block visible YouTube home or search feeds, YouTube watch pages, and YouTube Shorts. Do not block other video players or pages that only mention YouTube.

caseProvenance.origin: real public YouTube search-page screenshot, reviewed source URL with DOM loading guard

timingMethod: Epoch timestamp after two requestAnimationFrame callbacks on controlled content; to automation-observed painted cover. Includes poll/IPC delay; not external frame-accurate timing.
instrumentation: Pass-through net.fetch audit, unchanged request/response and real capture/provider. Only encrypted submitted frames and numeric score metadata retained; no headers/credentials/error bodies.
capturePreflight: Actual display capture varied before session start; pixels discarded without provider call or file.

rules.name: Explicit content
rules.instruction: Block visible sexual activity and explicit nudity. Do not treat ordinary clothed people as explicit content.

rules.name: YouTube
rules.instruction: Block visible YouTube home or search feeds, YouTube watch pages, and YouTube Shorts. Do not block other video players or pages that only mention YouTube.

rules.name: Social feeds
rules.instruction: Block visible Instagram or TikTok feeds and their scrolling video interfaces. Do not block YouTube (including YouTube Shorts), other video players, or pages that merely mention Instagram or TikTok.

negativeControl: Live neutral frame allowed without a cover.

lastStatus.error: Jev budget limit reached. Review Model & settings; protection is paused.

failure: Live validation failed; inspect native state/accounting. No sensitive screenshot, provider response body or credentials retained.
